row.proto: uint32_t Sess_RaceStrategy_SolvePlanTyreSets_Recursive(void *alloc_ctx, void *strategy, void *plan_vec, void *compound_list, int32_t value_idx, float limit)
row.notes: Recursive validator/completer for a stint plan (vector of 0x38-byte stints at plan+8..+0x10). Sums available tyre-set capacity (sets with flag +0x19 in strategy+0x188[compound], float at set+0x10+value_idx*4) and compares it with plan length versus remaining laps (+0x234); checks rule flags in strategy+0x268 (bit 0x4000000 = need two different compounds, bit 0x8000000 = mandatory-compound/set-flag check via tyre component +0x9c68) and calls Sess_RaceStrategy_IsPlanValid. If every stint already has a set (or the plan passes) it finalises with 0x1436a7350, 0x1436a8460(plan, +0x234) and 0x1436a85a0 and returns the pass bool. Otherwise for each candidate compound it clones the plan into a 0x28-byte candidate {float cost=FLT_MAX, bool valid, vector}, appends a stint with an unused set (0x1436a48e0), recurses, scores valid candidates by summed stint time plus pit loss (+0x214), sorts candidates (0x1436b9c20) and copies the best back into plan_vec; returns its valid flag. Stint fields: +0 compound, +8 start lap or -1, +0xc length, +0x14 set age or -1, +0x24 set index. Good hook for forcing/inspecting AI tyre strategy.
